name: picture-in-picture
title: Picture in Picture
description: A small window in a corner of its place (the nearest positioned ancestor, e.g. the main area) showing what an agent is on while the conversation goes on: of its items (pages, terminals), the one it is on (active), following it from one to the next. Dots (or "2/12" past seven) say how many there are; a swipe across the preview, a sideways scroll, the left and right arrows or a dot go through them, and it then stays where the reader went, a Follow button taking it back (following, onFollowingChange; onShownChange says which it shows, e.g. to stream that one's frames only). Each is a card (its title and preview, at aspectRatio 16:10; 320px wide, 240px on a phone) or a pill of one line (its icon, line and status; up to 384px), as its form says or the reader makes it (Minimize; the pill's line shows the card again, or expands one with no preview); a terminal is best a pill of its last line, PictureInPictureLines its last lines for a card. Dragged by any part but its buttons, it lands in the corner it is let go nearest or thrown towards, sliding there (none with reduced motion); a tap on its preview is still a press; Shift and the arrow keys move it. corner/defaultCorner/onCornerChange in the reading direction, 16px (inset) from its place's edges and the safe areas. An item's attention is a strip under a card or the pill's line, in the text's colour with a ring, read out, the window nudged once. Expand (onExpand(id), e.g. into the side panel) and Close (onClose) are the app's; the app renders it while it shows.
